_comment: "Discard 2 cards with YELLOW color strips" -- the colour was a key DISCARD_CARD did not read, so the cost discarded 2 RANDOM cards of any colour and can_pay returned true on any two cards in hand: the ability was activatable with no yellow cards at all. Costs must block legality. The end-phase trigger was END_OF_TURN; the card says AT THE BEGINNING OF EACH END PHASE. Its gate used 'amount' where CARD_IN_ZONE reads count_gte, so it asked for the zone to contain cards rather than for TWO of them. Still approximated, and said so rather than left looking finished: the trigger fires for the controller only, where the card says EACH hero, and 'any hero may activate this ability' has no representation -- activation is controller-only.
